title: Add ability to Middle click to show "Present windows" for the virtual desktop
line: Middle-clicking a desktop in the Pager now shows that desktop's windows in KWin's window view, without switching to it.
explanation: The Pager's desktop mouse area only accepted the left button, so a middle click on a desktop did nothing and there was no way to see another desktop's windows without switching to it. The change accepts the middle button there and passes the window ids of that desktop (or activity, in the Activity Pager) to KWin's WindowView effect over D-Bus, the same call the Task Manager uses to show an app's windows. The desktop tooltip gains a line mentioning it when the effect is available.

commits.message:
applets/pager: show a desktop's windows on middle click

Middle-clicking a desktop in the pager did nothing, so seeing the windows
of another desktop meant switching to it first. Now it opens KWin's window
view with that desktop's windows, and the tooltip mentions this.

BUG: 524941

media.caption: Middle-clicking Desktop 2 in the Pager: nothing happens.
Middle-clicking Desktop 2 opens the window view with its Konsole and Dolphin windows, while staying on Desktop 1.

review.text: Clean QML implementation in the Pager applet that accepts middle-clicks on desktop delegates to invoke KWin's WindowView1 effect via org.kde.plasma.workspace.dbus with that desktop's or activity's window IDs, and adds a localized tooltip hint when the effect is available and windows are present. Because windowMouseArea only accepts Qt.LeftButton, middle-clicks over window outlines still reach desktopMouseArea, empty desktops remain a no-op, and the screenshots confirm both the window view and tooltip behavior.
